turns.question: What share of candidates who applied in September 2026 reached the interview stage or beyond?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for candidates who reached the interview stage or beyond, so I cannot give that share. The closest metrics are applications (3 candidates applied from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) and candidates in stage, which counts the candidates in each hiring stage on a given day rather than whether they ever reached a stage. Freshness: Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
